name: Edocman Lite
author: JoomDonation

sections.description:
Edocman Lite is a lightweight and free document management system for WordPress. It provides essential features to organize, manage, and display documents on your WordPress website with a beautiful, modern interface.

Key Features

  • Category Management – Organize documents in hierarchical categories with images and descriptions
  • Document Upload – Easy document upload with thumbnail support
  • Multiple Formats – Support for all major file formats (PDF, DOC, XLS, PPT, ZIP, etc.)
  • Modern UI – Beautiful, responsive design that works on all devices
  • Download Tracking – Monitor document downloads and views
  • Shortcode Support – Display categories and documents anywhere on your site
  • Widget Ready – Sidebar widget to display categories
  • Search Friendly – SEO optimized for better visibility
  • Translation Ready – Multilingual support

Perfect For

  • Educational institutions sharing course materials
  • Businesses organizing internal documents
  • Organizations providing downloadable resources
  • Websites offering documentation and guides
  • Projects sharing technical specifications

Shortcodes

Display Categories:
[edocman_lite_categories]

Display Documents:
[edocman_lite_documents category_id=”1″]

Display Document Details:
[edocman_lite_document]

Support

For support and documentation, please visit:
* Website: https://joomdonation.com
* Email: wordpress@joomdonation.com

Credits
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Edocman Lite”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Extract the ZIP file
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

After Activation

  1. Go to Edocman Lite in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Create categories for organizing your documents
  3. Upload documents and assign them to categories
  4. Use shortcodes to display content on your pages
sections.faq:
What file types are supported?

Edocman Lite supports all major file formats including PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, ZIP, RAR, TXT, and more.

Can I organize documents in categories?

Yes! You can create unlimited categories and subcategories to organize your documents hierarchically.

Are the documents accessible to everyone?

Yes, in the Lite version all published documents are publicly accessible. Permission controls are available in Edocman WP.

Can I track downloads?

Yes! The plugin automatically tracks the number of downloads and views for each document.

Is it responsive?

Absolutely! Edocman Lite features a modern, fully responsive design that works perfectly on all devices and screen sizes.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes! The plugin uses standard WordPress styling and can be customized with CSS. The interface automatically adapts to your theme.

How do I display documents on my pages?

Use the provided shortcodes:
– [edocman_lite_categories] – Display category list
– [edocman_lite_documents category_id="1"] – Display documents from category ID 1
– [edocman_lite_document] – Display document details

Where are uploaded files stored?

Files are stored securely in /wp-content/uploads/edocman-lite/ directory.

Can I migrate from Lite to Pro?

Edocman Lite uses the same database structure as Edocman WP. Activating Edocman WP on the same WordPress installation will recognise existing data.

Is it translation ready?

Yes! The plugin is fully translation ready with support for multilingual websites.
